I got one bag of the government fertilizer this year through the coupon, the one in the red and white bag, so I will put all of it on my maize field. My field is small, only about half an acre, but I don't want to waste any by giving it away when my brother got his own bag. I will also put the goat manure I collected there before planting. The agro-dealer gave me hybrid seed with the fertilizer, so I will plant that — it grows well if you feed it. My wife and I will do all the work with our hoes, we don't hire anyone and we don't spray anything, we just wait for the rains.
